meta.label: Leo
meta.title: Only When it's you
meta.placeholderBody: Este espacio queda abierto para cuando quieras sumar tu nota.

blocks.text:
The world feels loud when I'm alone

Every thought just cuts like stone

I've been chasing echoes in the dark

Trying to find where you left your mark

And I don't know how to feel this right

When everything breaks in, the quiet of night

I only feel safe when it's you

When the world fades and the noise breaks through

You're the silence inside of the storm

You're the reason I try to be more

I can fall, I can break, I can lose

But it only hurts

Only when it's you

They say time heals, but it lies

Some wounds live behind the eyes

You were the voice that pulled me free

Now it's just static where you used to be

And I don't want a love that feels like less

If it's not your name tangled in my brain

I only feel safe when it's you

When the world fades and the noise breaks through

You're the silence inside of the storm

You're the reason I try to be more

I can fall, I can break, I can lose

But it only hurts

Only when it's you

I don't need the world to understand

I just need your hand in my hand

If I disappear, let it be known

I was never whole when I was alone

I only feel safe when it's you

Not a soul, not a sound cuts through

You're the fire that still burns low

You're the ache I'll never show

I can fall, I can break, I can lose

But it only hurts

Yeah, it only hurts when it's you
-- Only When its you -- Bleeding Verse
